Mali.title: "Bismillah is darkness", the cult slogan of student demonstrations in France
Mali.summary: It is the story of a slogan, a slogan that we see everywhere, since mid-September, in the demonstrations and blockades of students in France and Belgium as well as on social networks. This slogan, reveals Linda Giguère, is "Bismillah is darkness"! But what does that mean?

Mali.title: Image Africa Mali, Burkina Faso, Niger: deadly clashes between rival factions in the Sahel of Al-Qaeda and the Islamic State
Mali.summary: Clashes of unprecedented magnitude have been taking place for several weeks between the Sahelian branches of the jihadists of the Islamic State (IS) and Al-Qaeda (JNIM) in the border area straddling Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger.

Mali.title: From Mali to Niger, how is Algeria regaining influence in the Sahel?
Mali.summary: Algeria seeks to regain its influence in the African Sahel region through military, security and economic movements, at a time of increasing regional and international competition for the region, with the growing presence of Russia, the UAE and Morocco. Foreign Policy magazine confirmed that Algeria is intensifying its moves to regain its security and military influence in the Sahel and Sahara region, in light of the escalation of security threats and the increasing presence of foreign powers seeking to expand its influence in the region.

Mali.title: Sahel: violent fighting between the jihadists of Jnim and those of the ISE at the Mali-Burkina border
Mali.summary: The Sahelian branch of the Islamic State claims to have killed more than 400 Jnim fighters a week ago in Udalan. A claim published this Thursday in Al Naba, the Islamic State's propaganda newspaper. "The balance sheets of the EIS are always false", tempers a West African researcher, a keen connoisseur of jihadist groups Several specialized sources assure that the deaths are numerous on both sides and that Islamic State commanders in the Sahel were killed by Jnim.

Mali.title: West Africa: Sahel - Violent fighting between Jnim and ISIS jihadists on the Mali-Burkina border
Mali.summary: Since August, there has been significant fighting between the jihadists of Jnim, linked to al-Qaeda, and their rivals the Islamic State in the Sahel (ISIS). These fights are taking place on the border between Mali and Burkina Faso, also not far from the Nigerian border. The last clashes took place at the end of last week, mainly on Friday, October 9 in Gonadaouri, in the Burkinabe province of Oudalan .

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa strike two terrorist positions near Dioura and Tongolo Coura
Mali.summary: Through the exploitation of precise intelligence, the Malian Armed Forces targeted two sites attributed to terrorist groups on 14 and 15 October 2026. These actions are part of the dynamics of surveillance, control and security operations in the national territory . Bamada.net-The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) continue their operations in different theaters of intervention in order to strengthen the security of the national territory and reduce the nuisance capacities of armed terrorist groups .

Mali.title: Sahel: violent fighting between the jihadists of Jnim and those of the ISE at the Mali-Burkina border
Mali.summary: Sahel: violent fighting between the jihadists of Jnim and those of ISIS at the Mali-Burkina border Major fighting has been taking place since August between the jihadists of Jnim, linked to al-Qaeda, and their rivals the Islamic State in the Sahel (ISIS). These fights are taking place on the border between Mali and Burkina Faso, also not far from the Nigerian border .

Burkina Faso.title: West Africa: A war within a war - The clash between JNIM and the Islamic State in the Sahel
Burkina Faso.summary: Ouagadougou — A war within a war. It is the one that takes place in the sands of the Sahara, in the area of the triple border between Mali, Niger and Burkina Faso, where the two main jihadist groups active in the region clash: Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM, Group in support of Islam and Muslims) and the Islamic State in the Sahel (ISIS). The former is affiliated with Al-Qaeda, while the latter is linked to the Islamic State.

Burkina Faso.title: Al-Qaeda and IS rivalry sparks fierce fighting across Sahel
Burkina Faso.summary: Jihadists from rival Al-Qaeda and Islamic State factions in the Sahel have clashed recently on an unprecedented scale in the borderlands spanning Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger, with claims of hundreds of fighters killed. The two extremist coalitions, which covet influence over the same areas and control of the same routes and local populations, have repeatedly clashed since 2019.

Niger.title: Maradi: Governor Takes Part in Friday Prayer Marking Closing of M62 National Prayer Tour
Niger.summary: Maradi, Oct 16 (ANP) – The Governor of the Maradi region, the Comptroller General of PoliceIssoufou Mamane, took part, this Friday, October 16, 2026, in the Friday prayer at the mosque of the Sultanate of Katsina, in the presence of the regional directors. This prayer was followed by a Qunut and Du'a session devoted to invocations for peace, security and stability in Niger .
